description: Screenshot of the headline area of a news article titled 'QAnon leaders look to rebrand after tech crack downs,' with a subheading saying the tactical shift came the same week Twitter released data stating its ban on QAnon-related accounts was severely limiting the conspiracy theory's reach. The article photo shows a demonstrator holding aloft a large black QAnon flag bearing a stars-and-stripes Q and the slogan 'Where we go one, we go all' at a street protest; storefront signs for a Disney Studio Store and a Ghirardelli Soda Fountain and Chocolate Shop are visible behind, consistent with Hollywood Boulevard in Los Angeles. Other marchers carry signs; the news outlet is not identified in the crop.

description: Page from a federal court exhibit — Case 1:17-cr-00232-EGS (United States v. Michael Flynn), Document 248-5, filed 09/24/20, page 20 of 25 — showing a table of text messages dated April 11-23, 2017 with columns for date/time, phone (redacted), inbox/outbox, and message text. The messages discuss meetings with 'Bill,' 'JB,' and 'Baker,' a case being assigned to John Durham rather than NSD, upcoming NYT and Guardian articles, and one participant's unease that an article mentioned they 'had the Trump investigation.' description: Screenshot of Q drop #2603 (board post No. 4278922, tripcode !!mG7VJxZNCI, Dec 12 2018 17:33:56 EST), which quotes the same tripcode's earlier post No. 4278743 from 11 minutes prior. The quoted post links a @paul_serran tweet and a House Oversight Committee hearing page on the Clinton Foundation, says 'Goodbye, Mr. Rosenstein,' asks whether '[RR]' is still overseeing the 'SC' (special counsel) and 'Where is HUBER?'. The reply suggests another prosecutor outside DC was assigned by Sessions with the same mandate/authority, calling it 'one for the history books.' All of this is the drop's claim, not established fact.

description: Screenshot of an 8chan post by Q (tripcode !!mG7VJxZNCI, ID 2d695a, No. 2847989, Sep 2 2018 12:25:11), replying to post >>2847946. The drop asks how '[DARPA] aka GOOG' might play a role in a claimed 'spy campaign against POTUS,' tells readers to 'Think GMAIL,' 'Think GMAIL DRAFTS,' and 'Think ES RESIGNATION,' and asserts 'It will [ALL] connect eventually.' The equation of DARPA with Google, the spy-campaign premise, and the connections implied are the drop's claims; 'ES' is Q shorthand commonly read as Eric Schmidt.
